# Labelled failure set (WP-08, 2026-10-27)

38 cases, each one a failure that a committed artifact records. No case is
invented: `source` is a repository file and `anchor` is a phrase that must still
appear in it after whitespace normalization, exactly once.
`tooling/check_failure_set.py` fails when a source disappears, an anchor stops
resolving, or an anchor resolves to more than one place, so the set cannot
drift away from its evidence.

States:

- `open` -- the failure has no recorded fix or re-measurement. These are the
  candidates a proposal may target.
- `covered` -- a later recorded run or change addresses it; `state_note` names
  which.
- `blocked` -- the measurement cannot run on this host; `state_note` names the
  blocker.

The `unit` column is the case id the source uses, so a row maps back to a
behavioral case, a trigger case, a role task, or a work-package artifact.
